title: Aqueous Settings
settings.helper_path.label: Configuration helper

overview.title: Aqueous configuration
overview.description: Typed compositor settings with safe drafts, validation, and atomic writes.
overview.workspace_layout.description: Switch the active workspace on this panel's output immediately. This is a runtime override and does not edit your configuration files.

category.appearance: Effects, reserved space, opacity, and workspace animation.
category.layouts: Global layout geometry, layout slots, and engine behavior.
category.displays: Declarative display startup and fallback policy.
display.title: Monitor layout
display.description: Arrange connected and configured monitors visually, then apply the layout through Aqueous's declarative output policy.
display.drag_hint: Drag monitors beside, above, or below one another. Use the controls below for exact coordinates and rotation.
display.empty: No connected or configured monitors were found.
category.rules: Game Mode policy and rule defaults.
category.keybinds: Every built-in shortcut, custom command binding, and command behind Aqueous actions.
keybind.title: Keybindings
keybind.description: Configure every built-in Aqueous shortcut and each custom command binding from wm.toml.
keybind.multiple_hint: Separate multiple shortcuts with commas. Clear a field to unbind that action.
category.advanced: Edit complete files for repeated tables, custom bindings, profiles, and unknown settings.
category.collections_hint: This category's ordered collections are available in Advanced as complete TOML. Typed collection cards can be added without changing the helper protocol.
advanced.title: Advanced TOML
advanced.description: Complete configuration files, including output blocks, workspace mappings, rules, keybindings, gestures, and startup commands. Changes are still generation-checked and validated before writing.
advanced.outputs_warning: outputs.toml overrides physical display settings from wm.toml. Settings not present there continue to inherit from wm.toml.
status.user_override: Apply will create a writable user override; the system file remains unchanged
status.valid: Validation passed; changes are still drafts
status.applied: Applied; Aqueous will hot-reload the changed files
